name: Colour clash
description: An open book in 8-bit pixel art on an attribute grid, one ink and one paper to each 8 × 8 cell: yellow pages with black lines of text on a blue cover, and a red ribbon whose cells turn the text beside it red; the cells either side of the gutter lose their bright bit, shading the pages in blocks.
choices: Colour set per cell, not per pixel, so the ribbon clashes with the text it crosses, as sprites did on the hardware
No border, plasma or tile: the book stands alone, one screen pixel to each art pixel at 203 × 74
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
